data.value.spawnUnits.neutralTeam.descri: Spawn the unit on the neutral team instead of the same team as source
data.value.spawnUnits.setToTeamOfLastAtt: Set To Team Of Last Attacker
Spawn the unit on the last attacker of source (useful on [core]unitsSpawnedOnDeath)
data.value.spawnUnits.spawnChance.descri: Chance this unit will spawn. Defaults to 1.
data.value.spawnUnits.spawnSource.descri: Changes spawn location and team of spawned units to this unit ref.
data.value.spawnUnits.maxSpawnLimit.desc: Useful with spawnChance, max number of units to spawn in total
data.value.spawnUnits.gridAlign.descript: Align spawn location to grid, useful for buildings
Don't spawn this unit if spawn in an invalid location. Eg on units or over water when LAND based
data.value.spawnUnits.offsetX.descriptio: Sets horizontal position relative to source
data.value.spawnUnits.offsetY.descriptio: Sets vertical position relative to source
data.value.spawnUnits.offsetDir.descript: Set the facing direction of spawned units
data.value.spawnUnits.offsetHeight.descr: Sets the height for spawned units
data.value.spawnUnits.offsetRandomX.desc: Sets random horizontal position relative to source
data.value.spawnUnits.offsetRandomY.desc: Sets random vertical position relative to source
data.value.spawnUnits.offsetRandomDir.de: Set random facing direction of spawned units
data.value.spawnUnits.addResources.descr: Give spawn unit those resources, can be used to set flags that trigger actions
data.value.spawnUnits.transportedUnitsTo: Puts the designated amount of transported units into the transport of the spawned unit.
Copies all waypoints on target to created units.
data.value.spawnUnits.alwayStartDirAtZer: Sets the direction of spawned unit to 0 degrees.
data.value.spawnUnits.techLevel.descript: Usually used in BR maps, controls the size of safe zone markers and damaging borders. 1 techLevel = 10x10 tiles = 200 pixels in diameter
